reviews.body: Please don't reintroduce float, see inline.
Tests need the usual naming and factories.

comments.author: alice
comments.body:
Keep Decimal end-to-end. We just spent #103 getting floats out of the charge path, and
these `float()` casts put them straight back into the one comparison that decides
whether a capture goes through: `float(Decimal("0.3")) - float(Decimal("0.1"))` is not
0.2. Both sides are already Decimal from the model, so just subtract them.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Leftover from debugging the comparison with a float in the test. Removing the casts.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Done, plain Decimal arithmetic now and the error message prints the Decimal.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Could you rename these to the `test_<unit>__<scenario>__<expected>` form from CONTRIBUTING, e.g. `test_capture_charge__partial_amount__records_captured_amount` and `test_capture_charge__exceeds_remaining__raises_conflict`? When one fails in CI the name alone should tell you what broke. And please use `make_charge(...)` from `tests/factories.py` instead of the local `_charge()` builder. Every test file growing its own builder is how we ended up with six slightly different fake charges last year.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Fair on both. `make_charge` just needs `status="authorized"` and `captured_amount=Decimal("0")` overrides.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Renamed and switched to the factory.
